Victrola Willow - Retro Wood Bluetooth Radio, AM/FM - Walnut

$79.99
The Victrola Willow hides modern Bluetooth streaming and an AM/FM tuner inside a beautiful retro walnut cabinet. It's a compact tabletop radio that actually sounds warm and full — not tinny like most novelty retro speakers. The physical knobs for volume and tuning are satisfying to use, and the wood finish fits naturally on a bookshelf, nightstand, or kitchen counter. Great gift for anyone who wants music without staring at another screen.
